hero.intro: I configure servers, plugins, bots and permissions — then build the staff structure that keeps them running long after handover. Six years of setups that stayed stable.

panel.title: Taking on new builds
panel.body: Two slots open this month for full network configurations or Discord rebuilds. Smaller plugin and permission jobs usually turn around inside a week.
panel.footnote: Every build ships with written documentation and a walkthrough call, so your team can run it without me.

pillars.title: Four things, done to a standard.
pillars.kicker: Most setups break because nobody wrote down how they work. I configure the system and the process behind it.

items.title: Server configuration
items.body: Paper and Purpur tuning, Velocity proxy networks, world management and the performance pass that keeps TPS flat under load.

items.title: Plugin configuration
items.body: Permissions, economies, custom items, quests and menus — configured to fit each other rather than fighting for the same handlers.

items.title: Discord engineering
items.body: Channel architecture, role hierarchies, onboarding flows, ticket systems and the automation that keeps moderation from becoming a full-time job.

items.title: Staff & team management
items.body: Hiring rubrics, training paths, shift rotas and escalation ladders. I build teams that make decisions without waiting for an owner to wake up.

items.title: Community operations
items.body: Rule sets that hold up under argument, appeal processes that stay fair, and retention loops that bring players back without bribery.

items.title: Hosting & infrastructure
items.body: Panel setup, backup schedules, staged migrations and monitoring — so a bad night is an inconvenience rather than a rollback.

timelinePreview.title: Where I have been.
timelinePreview.kicker: A run through the networks and communities I have configured, led, or rescued.

workPreview.title: On the bench right now.
workPreview.kicker: Live builds, with an honest read on how far along each one actually is.

skillsPreview.title: Configuration and leadership.
skillsPreview.kicker: The technical side keeps the server up. The management side keeps it worth logging into.

reviewsPreview.title: What owners say after.
reviewsPreview.kicker: Feedback from network owners, community managers and staff leads I have worked with.

closing.title: Let's build something worth logging into.
closing.body: Tell me what you are running, what keeps breaking, and where you want it in six months. I will tell you honestly whether I am the right person for it.
